properties.information:
If you have any questions, please contact the project team on 1800 517 177, or visit www.tmr.qld.gov.au/b2n to sign up to receive project updates and find out more about the project.
Motorists should expect changed traffic conditions such as intermittent stoppages, lane closures and reduced speed limits at night on Steve Irwin Way, Glass House Mountains, between Moffatt Road and Barrs Road, from Sunday 6 September for up to three weeks (Sun-Thur, 6pm-5am), weather and construction conditions permitting.
Motorists are advised to follow traffic control and directional signage and plan their journey ahead of time. Where possible, priority access through the work zone will be given to emergency vehicles.
